excerpts.text: **Mount Mitchell** (_Attakulla_ in [Cherokee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cherokee_language "Cherokee language"))[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Mitchell#cite_note-Bradford-3) is the highest peak of the [Appalachian Mountains](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appalachian_Mountains "Appalachian Mountains") and the highest peak in mainland [North America](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_America "North America") east of the [Mississippi River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mississippi_River "Mississippi River"). It is located near [Burnsville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burnsville,_North_Carolina "Burnsville, North Carolina") in [Yancey County](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yancey_County,_North_Carolina "Yancey County, North Carolina"), [North Carolina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Carolina "North Carolina"), in the [Black Mountain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Mountains_(North_Carolina) "Black Mountains (North Carolina)") subrange of the Appalachians about 19 miles (31 km) northeast of [Asheville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asheville,_North_Carolina "Asheville, North Carolina"). It is protected by [Mount Mitchell State Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Mitchell_State_Park "Mount Mitchell State Park") and surrounded by the [Pisgah National Forest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pisgah_National_Forest "Pisgah National Forest"). Mount Mitchell's elevation is 6,684 feet (2,037 m) above sea level.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Mitchell#cite_note-pb-1) Mount Mitchell is ranked 31st by [topographic isolation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topographic_isolation "Topographic isolation").

The second highest point in eastern North America, [Mount Craig](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Craig_(North_Carolina) "Mount Craig (North Carolina)") at 6,647 feet (2,026 m), is roughly a mile to the north of Mount Mitchell.

excerpts.text: At an [elevation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Topographical_summit "Topographical summit") of 6,643 feet (2,025 m), it is the highest mountain in the [Great Smoky Mountains National Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Smoky_Mountains_National_Park "Great Smoky Mountains National Park"), the highest point in the state of Tennessee, and the highest point along the 2,192-mile (3,528 km) [Appalachian Trail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appalachian_Trail "Appalachian Trail"). It is also the third highest point in eastern mainland North America, after [Mount Mitchell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Mitchell "Mount Mitchell") (6,684 feet or 2,037 meters) and [Mount Craig](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Craig_(North_Carolina) "Mount Craig (North Carolina)") (6,647 feet or 2,026 meters).
